intro.description: Optional one or two sentences above the items (plain text).

action.description: Optional. What the bot does with the bot items you approve: post, send or continue. Names the bot in the task banner (Approve and the bot sends). The footer reads Send decisions. The result does not change.

approve.description: Label of the approve choice instead of Approve. The result value stays approve.

reject.description: Label of the reject choice instead of Reject. The result value stays reject.

defer.description: Label of the defer choice instead of Defer. The result value stays defer.

labels.description: Optional button labels for bot items, plain text of 1-24 characters each, e.g. {"approve": "Pay", "defer": "Next week"}. An item's own labels win. The rows and the status use them; the banner does not. The result keeps approve, reject and defer. Each choice of an item needs its own label: a label that repeats another choice of that item, also a default label such as Reject, is rejected at show.

items.description: The items to decide, at most 12 per screen. Shown one at a time in this order; every id is different. An item is a bot item (no actor, or actor bot) or a user item (actor user).

id.description: Stable id, unique within the payload (a repeated id is rejected); echoed in the result.

kind.description: Optional short category shown above the title, e.g. "Expense".

source.description: Optional requester, sender or counterparty; also names the item in the status line.

title.description: One-line summary of what is to be decided. http(s) addresses in the text become links.

detail.description: Optional short detail (a snippet, never a full document). http(s) addresses in the text become links.

content.description: Optional. Set post or reply when the person publishes this item: the choice then reads Posted. Without it a user item reads Done. The result value is still done.

url.description: Optional http(s) address of the post to reply under or the target. A hostname of ASCII letters, digits, hyphens and dots is required (punycode for an IDN; no IP literal in brackets). No backslash or control character. Credentials are rejected only in the authority; @ may appear in the path, query or fragment. Also checked with the opener (x-rs-url). Shown as one link on its own line when it can be opened. The same address is not linked again in the title or detail.

due.description: Optional due date YYYY-MM-DD, a real calendar day (2026-02-31 is rejected).

copy.description: Values the person would otherwise retype (reference, amount, reply draft). Each is shown in full next to its button.

text.description: Exact string that lands on the clipboard.

actor.description: bot (default): the bot does the next step. Choices Approve, Reject, Defer; results approve / reject / defer.

approve.description: Label of the approve choice instead of Approve. The result value stays approve.

reject.description: Label of the reject choice instead of Reject. The result value stays reject.

defer.description: Label of the defer choice instead of Defer. The result value stays defer.

labels.description: Optional labels for this item's choices; they win over the top-level labels. Each choice needs its own label (checked at show).

choices.description: Choice buttons for this item, in this order. No choice is preselected.

done.description: What the agent already handled without a decision; shown under one closed disclosure.
